facts.fact_text: On 1 May 1999, a group of people, including the applicants, gathered in the building of the Health Workers' Trade Union.
On 1 May 1999, the group that had gathered in the building of the Health Workers' Trade Union started to walk towards the Adıyaman Amphitheatre for the May Day celebrations.
The group walking towards the Adıyaman Amphitheatre was stopped by police officers.
The police intervened to disperse the group that was attempting to continue its march towards the Adıyaman Amphitheatre.

According to the incident report, thirty-eight people, including the applicants, were arrested during the incident on 1 May 1999.

In his decision of 1 June 1999, the Adıyaman Public Prosecutor indicated that, pursuant to section 24 of the Assemblies and Marches Act (Law no. 2911), the police were under an obligation to warn the group out loud to disperse.

In his decision of 1 June 1999, the Adıyaman Public Prosecutor observed from the video recording of the incident that the police had failed to warn the group out loud to disperse as required by section 24 of the Assemblies and Marches Act (Law no. 2911).
